subject: Author the qualification-run contracts: lifecycle record, cleanup state, budgets, typed UNKNOWN causes, providers, PowerShell edition and the traceability manifest fields
description:
RESULT (2026-10-04, AMC-D-PF3XTNPM): Loom commit 8fd7e6e, pushed (f13d98f..8fd7e6e). Superproject pointer bumped in b366091 (pushed). Worker: a fresh loom-worker (Opus), dispatched after the reboot and verified by the orchestrator. Handle in metadata; resume it for task 9.

DELIVERED (names are final; tasks 16, 17, 19 and 26 carry the follow-ups):
- common.schema.json: MachinePath, EnvironmentKind, UnavailableCause (10 causes), LifecyclePhase (preflight…release), CleanupState (pending|running|clean|failed), CleanupOutcome, ProviderKind (localdb|developer-service), ProcessIdentity {pid, createdAt}.
- model.schema.json: SqlPlatform (Storage.platform refers to it, same values).
- profile.schema.json: ToolName gains `powershell` (Desktop) beside `pwsh` (Core); PowerShellEdition Desktop|Core; VersionPolicy.edition is optional.
- assurance.schema.json:
  - Policy.execution {providers, budgets: RunBudgets} is required. Every Policy instance was updated: qualification/policy.json, three qualification fixtures, the core fixture and five test helpers.
  - RunRecord, required: runId, inputDigest (runInputDigest in run.ts), runner, startedAt, finishedAt, revisionSet (with optional policy, implementation, fixtures and assertions), checks (optional cause and dependency; the per-check evidence member was removed, because EvidenceRecord.check.id owns the link), evidenceRefs, testOutcome.
  - RunRecord, optional until tasks 16 and 17: target, provider, engineVersion, outcome, cleanup, resourceUsage, limits.
  - New records: RunBudgets, ProviderRef, ProviderConfiguration, RunResourceKind, RunCleanup, AllocationJournal, RunLease, ReleaseEvidence.
  - EvidenceRecord: environment.kind refers to EnvironmentKind; tool.edition is optional.
  - CapabilityRegister: owner, negativeVerification, proofLimits, environments and evidenceRefs, all optional.
- tools.schema.json: QualifyRunStatus.cleanup is CleanupState, and its progress events gain an optional cause. QualifyCancelData.cleanup is RunCleanup. CleanupReport.steps.outcome refers to CleanupOutcome.
- Code: run.ts emits the new members; revision.ts, the cli commands and selftest switched (decision 12); tools.ts has a minimal `powershell` locator, because the exhaustive switch needs one.
- Tests: framework.test.ts gains a run-record contract test; contract.test.ts gains a budget-enforcement-vocabulary guard.
- capabilities.json gains `contract.qualification-run` (131 entries). README.md and Docs/workflow-integration.md were updated; no ICD names a renamed member.

VERIFIED (orchestrator, once, on the final tree):
- build: 8 artifacts current, 566 fixture cases passed, digest sha256:509ed5edff1a8730f281dde0d26200116feb765b5a7dc36543fabf8722b88bf6.
- Core battery PASS: 24 sections, 2425 assertions.
- Suites: contract 14/14, framework 24/24, cli 32/32, trust 10/10, concurrency 5/5, mcp 21/21, adoption fixtures 59/59.
- native.test.js "every profile check passes against Loom's own fixtures under the self-qualification policy": 1/1.
- smoke PASS: tools/list 38,779 bytes (budget 98,304); largest tool loom.planChange 4,412 (budget 8,192); 45 schema resources.
- coverage --check with the contract, framework and cli TAP results: 131 capabilities, 231 verified references, 0 findings on contract.qualification-run. The remaining 274 are all CAPABILITY_CASE_FAILED for cases in suites not supplied; there are 0 unresolved code, contract or case findings.
- docs --check --self: 0 findings.
- Designer build OK.
- Designer tests: the full ng test run timed out 3 tests at vitest's 5,000 ms default while the host CPU sat at 100% (the Embedding-Service server, the iii engine and two peer sessions; 2.3 GB free). Run per spec file, all 29/29 pass: guided-edit 1, loom-store 6, persistence 4, record-editor 6, states 7, views 3, workflow 2. Recorded in task 28.
- `SqlLocalDB info`: only MSSQLLocalDB, before and after.
- The commit message has no prohibited markers.

ACCEPTED DEVIATIONS:
- Three inline vocabularies were named instead of copied (SqlPlatform, EnvironmentKind, CleanupOutcome).
- RunCleanup.outcomes is one array keyed by RunResourceKind.
- revisionSet.policy {ref, revision, hash} matches Baseline.policy and RevisionSet.policy, where ref is the policy id.
- CapabilityRegister uses evidenceRefs (an array).
- Two conditional rules live in descriptions only, because the generator has no if/then keyword: recovery when residual, and succeeded only with PASS and clean cleanup. Tasks 16, 17 and 19 enforce their conditionals in code.
- The test names and the policy.ts `aggregate()` function keep "aggregate", because capability case ids reference them; aggregate is the operation that yields testOutcome.
- The worker wrote three temporary TAP files with [IO.File]::WriteAllText, breaking the console's write rule, and deleted them.

FOUND, NOT FIXED: qualification/metrics.json records contract digest sha256:baef98… (stale before this task). It is recorded in task 28 step 1.
Crosswalk evidence recorded on all 21 statements. #362 and #368 stay open until tasks 16 and 17 (co-owners) complete.
